svg.aria-label: Commit Breakout: a self-playing Breakout level where every brick is a day of commits from the last year (327 days, 4,203 commits, private repositories included). The busiest day triggers multiball, the start of the 27-day streak triggers fireball, and the score ends at 4,203.

svg.text: # 1 brick = 1 day of commits, private repos included · the public graph (5198) would leave this level empty
★ busiest day → multiball · ϟ streak start → fireball · bright days take 2 hits · score = commits destroyed · loops every 28s
